headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Is Pushing Further Into Live Programming And Cloud Gaming
headlines.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) is ramping up live programming, video podcasts and cloud gaming as new content pillars in its service. The company has announced a sizeable share repurchase plan, signaling a decision to return more capital to shareholders. Management is exploring a potential acquisition of Warner Bros., which would bring a large film and TV library under Netflix control. headlines.summary: Deutsche Bank upgraded Netflix stock, arguing that investors may be overlooking the streaming giant’s international growth opportunity.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
